subject: maths
question: A man spent 20% of his monthly income on rent and 45% of the remaining on clothes and he saves the remaining income. If his monthly savings are Rs.308, find his monthly salary.
solution:
**Given:**

Monthly savings = Rs. 308

A man spends 20% of his monthly income on rent.

He spends 45% of the remaining income on clothes.

**Formula Used:**

Let the monthly income be Rs. x.

Amount spent on rent = 20% of x = 0.20x

Remaining income after rent = x - 0.20x = 0.80x

Amount spent on clothes = 45% of remaining income = 45% of 0.80x = 0.45 × 0.80x = 0.36x

Savings = Remaining income after clothes

Savings = 0.80x - 0.36x = 0.44x

Savings = Rs. 308

**Calculation:**

⇒ 0.44x = 308

⇒ x = 308 / 0.44

⇒ x = 700

**The monthly salary is Rs. 700.**
